profile.name: Lars
profile.overview: Lars is a simple, solid all-rounder with good generics and stance mixups, strong block punishment and great combo damage. Simple to pick up and play, and boasting some very flashy moves, Lars is a great choice for the Tekken beginner as he is very safe (most of his moves are -12 on block).
profile.playstyle: A simple, solid all-rounder. Good generic pokes, strong punishment and great combo damage, plus stance mix-ups through Dynamic Entry (DEN), Silent Entry (SEN) and Limited Entry (LEN). Wavu notes his counter-hit game is below average apart from 1,1,1, so win by punishing and by stance pressure, not by fishing.
strengths: Tricky: Strong stance mixups, and new extensions and stance transitions can easily confuse opponents.
Fundamental: Good generic tools make him well rounded, fit to tackle any kind of opponent.
Watch your ankles: Decent selection of lows, especially with Heat active.
Punishing: Strong block punishment, with ability to launch at i14 standing, making Lars quite dangerous should his opponents be careless with their move selections.
weaknesses: Bad at fishing: Other than his 1,1,1, his CH game is below average; he has no other fast options, and CH launchers are not any faster than his existing natural launchers.
Slow Dancer: His great single backdash distance is offset by having a very awkward cancel window.

stances.name: Dynamic Entry
stances.note: DEN.1+2 is i12 and tornadoes; DEN.1,2 and DEN.3 are Heat Engagers; DEN.3 is +5 on block.

stances.name: Silent Entry
stances.entry: df+2, f+2,1 and others transition here; also used with ~f in combos
stances.note: SEN.1 is an i12 Heat Engager; SEN.2 is a low; SEN.4 is a homing high, +4 on block; SEN.1+2 is a power crush that tornadoes.

stances.name: Limited Entry
stances.note: A low-profile stance; LEN.2 tornadoes. Heat empowers LEN moves (Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: Delta Slicer: Heat Engager string, his main counter-hit tool (Wavu).
keyMoves.purpose: Fast string that rewards presses and starts Heat.
keyMoves.use: When the opponent presses after you.
keyMoves.avoid: -12 if the whole string is blocked.

keyMoves.summary: Flash Bullet: i14 mid, -3 on block, transitions to SEN.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid into stance pressure.
keyMoves.use: To check and go into SEN.

keyMoves.summary: Tactical Sword: i18 mid, +0c on block.
keyMoves.purpose: A safe mid that spikes on counter hit.

keyMoves.summary: i13 high string into SEN, -5 on block.
Ark Blast: i15 mid, -13 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: His i15 punish and BnB starter (Wavu).

keyMoves.summary: Blue Bolt: i16 launcher, -18 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: An i14 punisher on Wavu's table.

keyMoves.summary: Lightning Screw: i16 knee launcher, -26 on block.
Streamer: i15 while-standing tornado, -12 on block.
Shell Smash: i11 while-standing kick, -6 on block.
Shadow Cutter: i20 low, -26 on block, launches on counter hit.
Turbine Hook: i17 low from SEN, -12 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: The low side of his SEN mix-up.

keyMoves.summary: Red Sprite: i20 mid from a run, +6 on block.
keyMoves.use: To close distance and keep the turn.

keyMoves.summary: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
